phase_title: receiver validator 実装許可の最終実測発効可否レポート設計
phase_purpose: Phase 15 最終実測確定判定層：receiver_validator_implementation_permission を最終実測データから EFFECTIVE/NOT_EFFECTIVE 判定するレポート構造を設計する
execution_context: reports-only design phase; no actual permission activation or app/tests implementation until confirmed

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. receiver_validator_implementation_permission activation (EFFECTIVE) is contingent on integrated_decision=GO. No app/tests implementation permitted until both confirmations are measured.
governance.hard_stop_condition: receiver_validator_implementation_permission must remain NOT_EFFECTIVE in all template fields until integrated_decision_final_actual_status=GO and actual measurement confirms permission readiness

report_structure.report_type: Final Actual Measurement Permission Feasibility Report
report_structure.report_timing: Upon Phase 15-7 (integrated_decision final measurement) decision confirmation AND completion of Phase 15-1, 15-2 input entry

measurement_timestamp.requirement: Timestamp of final actual permission feasibility measurement
measurement_timestamp.source: Actual human review and data entry completion time

integrated_decision_prerequisite_status.requirement: Must be GO before receiver_validator permission can be EFFECTIVE
integrated_decision_prerequisite_status.critical_rule: If integrated_decision = NO_GO, then receiver_validator_implementation_permission MUST be NOT_EFFECTIVE

evidence_lock_status_for_permission.requirement: All permission-related evidence from Phase 14-7 (receiver validator feasibility assessment) must be locked
evidence_lock_status_for_permission.confirmation_rule: Must be true before EFFECTIVE determination possible

criteria_list.description: All permission-related evidence must be locked and confirmed
criteria_list.confirmation_source: Phase 15-5 evidence lock rules and Phase 14-7 feasibility assessment

criteria_list.description: Phase 14-6 (GO stop conditions) must not block permission activation
criteria_list.confirmation_source: Phase 14-6 GO stop conditions for permission context

criteria_list.description: Phase 15-2 (receiver_validator input) must have concrete, non-template human review data
criteria_list.confirmation_source: Phase 15-2 receiver_validator input format completion check

criteria_list.description: All prerequisite phases (1-14) and implementation gates (Phase 10) must be confirmed complete

receiver_validator_permission_actual_mea.template_rule: In design phase, all template instances must show NOT_EFFECTIVE. Actual EFFECTIVE determination waits for confirmed integrated_decision=GO AND all 5 criteria validated.
receiver_validator_permission_actual_mea.effective_determination_rule: EFFECTIVE only when integrated_decision=GO AND ALL 5 criteria above are TRUE AND measurement timestamp recorded AND human review has entered concrete data into Phase 15-2
receiver_validator_permission_actual_mea.not_effective_maintenance_rule: NOT_EFFECTIVE is default and safe state. Maintain NOT_EFFECTIVE if: (1) integrated_decision != GO, OR (2) any criterion fails, OR (3) Phase 14-6 stop conditions block activation, OR (4) Phase 15-2 human input incomplete

readiness_factors.requirement: All phases 8-9 (Phase 9 transition) through 14-9 (Phase 14 completion) must be PASS_DESIGN_ONLY
Phase 10 (implementation pre-gates) must have all gates cleared and ready
Phase 15-7 must confirm integrated_decision = GO from actual human review data
readiness_factors.current_status: PENDING (awaits Phase 15-7 measurement and human data entry)

implementation_readiness_detail.combined_readiness_logic: app/tests implementation ONLY becomes GO when BOTH integrated_decision=GO AND receiver_validator_implementation_permission=EFFECTIVE are confirmed

confidence_assessment.template_rule: In design phase, all instances show UNCONFIRMED. Actual levels depend on completeness of human review data and integrated_decision outcome.

recommendation_for_app_implementation.template_rule: In design phase, default to HALT. Actual recommendation depends on: (1) integrated_decision status, (2) receiver_validator_permission status, (3) all 5 criteria validation

primary_sources: Phase 15-2 receiver_validator_implementation_permission final actual measurement input (human review entry)
Phase 15-7 integrated_decision final actual measurement report (decision result)
Phase 14-7 receiver validator implementation feasibility assessment
secondary_sources: Phase 14-6 GO stop conditions evaluation for permission context
All preceding phase completion declarations (8-10 through 14-9)

step_1_integrated_decision_prerequisite_.halt_condition: If integrated_decision = NO_GO, HALT and set receiver_validator_implementation_permission = NOT_EFFECTIVE (final)

step_2_permission_evidence_lock_verifica.action: Verify Phase 15-5 evidence lock completion for permission-related evidence
step_2_permission_evidence_lock_verifica.condition: All permission evidence must be confirmed locked
step_2_permission_evidence_lock_verifica.halt_condition: If evidence not locked, HALT and return to Phase 15-5

step_3_permission_stop_conditions_check.action: Check Phase 14-6 for permission-blocking stop conditions
step_3_permission_stop_conditions_check.condition: No stop conditions can block permission activation
step_3_permission_stop_conditions_check.halt_condition: If blocking stops are active, HALT and return to Phase 14-6

step_4_criteria_validation.halt_condition: If any criterion is FALSE, set receiver_validator_implementation_permission = NOT_EFFECTIVE and HALT

step_5_human_review_permission_data_conf.action: Confirm Phase 15-2 human review data entry is complete and concrete
step_5_human_review_permission_data_conf.condition: Data must not be template-only; must contain actual human decision
step_5_human_review_permission_data_conf.halt_condition: If data missing or template-only, HALT and request human review input to Phase 15-2

step_6_final_permission_determination.logic: IF integrated_decision=GO AND all 5 criteria TRUE AND no stops AND permission evidence locked AND human data complete THEN permission=EFFECTIVE; ELSE permission=NOT_EFFECTIVE

step_7_app_implementation_readiness_asse.action: Generate final app/tests implementation readiness recommendation
step_7_app_implementation_readiness_asse.logic: IF permission=EFFECTIVE THEN recommend PROCEED_TO_APP_IMPLEMENTATION; IF permission=NOT_EFFECTIVE THEN recommend HALT_AND_REASSESS

relationship_to_phase_15_7.dependency: Phase 15-7 (integrated_decision final measurement) is a prerequisite for Phase 15-8
relationship_to_phase_15_7.execution_order: Phase 15-7 decision result (GO or NO_GO) feeds directly into Phase 15-8 step_1_integrated_decision_prerequisite_check
relationship_to_phase_15_7.combined_effect: Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 together determine whether app/tests implementation gate opens (requires BOTH GO and EFFECTIVE)

depends_on: Phase 15-2: receiver_validator_implementation_permission final actual measurement input format
Phase 15-7: integrated_decision final actual measurement report (decision prerequisite)
Phase 14-7: receiver validator implementation feasibility assessment
feeds_into: Phase 15-9: Phase 15 completion declaration (both 15-7 and 15-8 results)
Phase 16 (potential): app/tests implementation permission activation (if both 15-7 GO and 15-8 EFFECTIVE confirmed)

design_review_checklist: Report structure captures all 5 permission criteria
integrated_decision prerequisite check is mandatory first step
Evidence lock verification is enforced before determination
Permission-blocking stop conditions are checked explicitly
Human review data entry is required (not auto-determined)
Default template value is NOT_EFFECTIVE (safety-first default)
Implementation readiness assessment is tied to permission status
Measurement workflow is sequential with clear halt points
Relationship to Phase 15-7 is clearly established
All blocked actions remain in governance
Phase dependencies are accurate and complete

completion_gate.gate_condition: Design structure approved AND design review checklist all confirmed
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 15-9 (completion declaration) requires both Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8 approval
